answer_plain: 本次没有证明财务指标能增加月平均收益；毛利与动量的固定混合，在同一批股票平均配置下跌的月份，显示较一致的少亏证据，值得保留为有限的历史风险用途线索。共同股票范围里59个这样的月份，相对仅动量平均少亏0.3454个百分点；按连续12个月重抽得到的97.5%范围为少亏0.1020至0.5670个百分点。经营现金单独选择相对全体平均也有下跌月少亏线索，但加入动量后的额外改善仍不确定。这些结果没有证明能提前识别下跌、获得更多收益、超过波动等全部已有信息，或在个人账户与ETF上实现。

complete_risk_comparison.interpretation: The confidence ranges describe the chosen historical resampling procedure; they are not the probability that the causal effect is true, and they do not account for selecting this follow-up after observing multiple core risk summaries.

Common pool B-M+0.3454pp,6month[+0.1008,+0.5762],12month[+0.1020,+0.5670]. B-D and B-P are also positive across both block lengths, confidence levels,scenarios and both GP pools.
gp_mixed_downside_month_use.stability: Primary B-M2015-2019+0.3401pp/2020-2025+0.3352pp; common+0.3184/+0.3683pp. Removing any one year leaves primary+0.3041 to+0.4124pp/common+0.2961 to+0.4126pp.
gp_mixed_downside_month_use.counterexamples: GP primary B-M on down months is negative in2019 and2021; full-period worst month of GP B is slightly worse than M, and early-period worst-tenth-month average is also slightly worse. It is not all-risk improvement.
gp_mixed_downside_month_use.claim_limit: Observed under the fixed blend and source-qualified pool versus specified simple industry-controlled momentum/dilution. Neither every future decline nor independent financial causality is established.

cfo_added_to_momentum.evidence: Common B-M+0.2998pp,97.5%6month[-0.1356,+0.7146],12month[-0.1767,+0.7636]. Even95% intervals cross0. B-D at95%6months alone is positive, but12months and both97.5% intervals cross0; cannot choose the favorable setting.
cfo_added_to_momentum.counterexamples: B-M down-month difference2015-2019+0.7153pp but2020-2025-0.0509pp; later B-D-0.0369pp and B-P-0.0229pp. Better full-sample marked drawdown/worst-month descriptions cannot override this instability.

standalone_financial_risk.evidence: Common CFO F-P+0.4226pp,97.5%6month[+0.0628,+0.8057],12month[+0.0670,+0.7664]. Common GP F-P+0.3671pp has positive97.5%intervals too. GP primary F-P+0.2898pp is positive only at95%;97.5%intervals include0, revealing qualification-pool sensitivity.
standalone_financial_risk.stability: CFO F-P down-month mean+0.7360pp in2015-2019 and+0.1582pp in2020-2025; GP primary+0.5681/+0.0620pp and common+0.5556/+0.2080pp.
standalone_financial_risk.limit: A positive F-P conditional-risk difference is not evidence of incremental value after momentum, and common-versus-primary observations are not independent replications. All B-F uncertainty intervals cross0.

diversification_and_maintenance.evidence: Common F-M return correlation about0.973GP/0.977CFO despite rank correlations0.044/0.078. Target replacement about27.02% for M,14.57/14.95% for F,25.17/25.18% for B and17.68% for D.
diversification_and_maintenance.limit: This is target-list change before realized holding drift, fills and fees. Financial-source/version maintenance adds work; human hours and net costs unmeasured. High co-movement does not disprove modest conditional risk benefit; it does rule out presenting low rank correlation as established independent portfolio behavior.

basis: The necessary risk uncertainty gap identified after the core is now answered using the already-frozen monthly series; return, risk and other-use claims can each be made with their actual evidence strength.
Both positive and negative evidence are preserved. No unresolved arithmetic discrepancy remains. A limited exploratory risk lead does not by itself require every possible baseline or a new market.

The existing joint industry-by-nine-cell audit leaves about93%weight in hold-all tiny cells and changes median B-M weights by only2.6%-2.9%;27/33/34 months are identical. It cannot fairly establish broad independence and should not be mechanically run as a pass/fail requirement.

required_final_limits: Follow-up chosen after seeing core risk results; it is exploratory.97.5%intervals are not a simultaneous guarantee across all metrics,comparisons or family attempts.
Retain fixed2014historical cohort, financial-qualified selection bias, incomplete sources, retrospective annual industry snapshots and about88%v2 measurement recovery with old notices unresolved.
The inspected price history is not an unseen validation set. Shared months/stocks and repeated annual values limit independent evidence.
Low statistical overlap is not investment usefulness. Limited historical risk evidence does not prove independent financial mechanism beyond volatility/liquidity/value.
No live state prediction, timing/switch rule, account fills, fees, corporate-action wealth or ETF application was tested. No originalLEI financial hard filter or trading adoption authorized.
final_fact_wording: 在这批历史可比股票中，毛利与动量各占一半的固定评分，没有证明能多赚钱；但在同池平均配置下跌的月份，相对简单动量平均少亏约0.34个百分点，前后时期方向一致，补充检验的不确定范围仍为正。可保留为有限风险用途的历史证据。经营现金单独选股也有少亏线索，加入动量后的额外保护尚不明确。本轮按此范围结案，不转为ETF或实盘规则。
